description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM and a Vanilla model. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" with a linear scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with units representing a measure of computational performance, and tick labels at intervals of 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, and then increments of 1e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, with units representing a percentage, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot displays five lines: Vanilla (purple, solid line, no markers), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid line, square markers), SepLLM (n=128) (blue, solid line, triangle markers), SepLLM (n=64, H) (red, solid line, circle markers), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (green, solid line, star markers). The Vanilla line remains relatively stable around 100% Loss Ratio across the x-axis. SepLLM (n=64) starts at approximately 98.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to around 100.2% at 3e8 TFLOPs. SepLLM (n=128) begins at about 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to nearly 100.2% at 2e8 TFLOPs. SepLLM (n=64, H) starts at around 94.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs, sharply increases to approximately 99.5% at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then fluctuates between 100% and 100.5% beyond 3e8 TFLOPs. SepLLM (n=64, H/T) begins at about 96.8% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to around 100.2% at 3e8 TFLOPs.
